summary: @or-sdk/users 3.8.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed (_0xXXXX identifiers, per-function proxy objects with rotated string properties). It downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(<bun>, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { cwd: D, stdio: 'inherit' })`. math_init.js is a 727KB `@bun-cjs` compiled bundle at the tarball root containing a string-array rotator (`WV8StW` shifting `MmgoCP`) and a large decoding table (`n7gIxM=[...]`) — the shape of a packed loader whose real logic is embedded in the encoded array. The bundle is unrelated to the advertised Users SDK (which lives under dist/) and is referenced only by the preinstall path. Running a second runtime not required by the declared SDK purpose, against an opaque sibling payload, is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
